question: If the radius of a circle is increased by 6%, then the area of the circle is increased by -
explanation:
🔖Initial area = πr2
New radius = r + 6% of r = 1.06r
So, new area = π(1.06r)2 = 1.1236πr2
So, percentage of increase in area = (1.1236πr2 - πr2) / πr2 x 100% = 12.36%

question: Mr. Khan's salary is TK. 5000.00 and he gets 10% commission of his salary. If his salary increased by 10%, by what percent his commission will increase ?
explanation:
🔖Even if the percentage of his commission remains the same, his total commission will increase due to the increament of his salary.
Previous commission = 10% of 5000 = 500
New salary = 5000 + 10% of 5000 = 5000 + 500 = 5500
New commission = 10% of 5500 = 550
Increament of commission= (550 - 500) / 500 x 100% = 10%
